Two intermediate attempts did not leave a reusable socket. A trace of the explicitly enabled warm-up showed native handling at 6614.801 ms after readiness at 4660.269 ms, across a platform hold. A one-second wall deadline is unsafe across such holds. Warm-up client start/timeout events were not logged, so the exact closure sequence in the failed attempt is not conclusively isolated. The Vercel start entry now enables warm-up explicitly without relying on runtime VERCEL, and the background request uses the normal 30-second RPC deadline. The earlier environment-only explanation was not established by the logs.
